question: Based on the position in the English alphabetical order, three of the following letter-clusters are alike in some manner and one is different. Select the odd letter-cluster.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e82b7da6e41b2a069e2db44b7b686c69a4d8afae6d389dc05a659aaeaa56953.png] 

According to English alphabet series 

The pattern followed here is:

1. CEIO → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9016c2c853247635830cf65b9594f20e251a28b77b77b97f3fc33d83db69d13c.png] 

**2. HJNU → ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9547d859736fa665867fe252dc76789cdaf4d609e472fa93d560a1b28a2ada8.png] 

3. JLPV → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/461389f5ba861b78148046578052e3643b5fa8fd360d90aec723dde0923840a8.png] 

4. FHLR → [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b83f8c5e5a6a60150b0434a16ab780a6efbc73afb0cf937736e1caa1db79814.png] 

HJNU is the odd letter-cluster

Hence, **"Option 2"** is the correct answer.
